Method of Attack: Injected malicious JavaScript code at checkout to capture billing information and send it to attacker's server
Obfuscated payload encoded in base64 to steal email, customer name, billing and shipping address, phone number, and card details (number, expiration date, CVV)
Discoverer: Mounir Hahad, head of Juniper Threat Labs at Juniper Networks
Attack Vector: Compromised website JavaScript file loaded at checkout
Indicators of Compromise: Command and control domain resolved 905 times since creation
